RVC Fabric

Real-time AI voice conversion and model training workbench for Windows

RVC Fabric is a free, open-source desktop application developed by Turing Mirror for voice calls, live streaming and audio production. It supports real-time voice changing, audio file conversion, vocal separation and voice model training, with runtime setup and model management.

Download for Windows .exe GitHub ↗（Opens in a new tab） CNB mirror (China) ↗（Opens in a new tab）

Supports Windows 10 and Windows 11. Download the required runtime and models before first use.

These archived interface screenshots were recorded in the repository in August 2026. The current interface may differ.

RVC Fabric User guide

Features

  • Real-time conversion

    Converts microphone input to the selected voice, with original-voice bypass, ASIO channel selection and independent monitoring. Latency depends on hardware, the model and audio settings.

  • DSP effect chain

    Includes a noise gate, compressor and 5-band parametric EQ, with presets and individual adjustments.

  • Voices & presets

    The voice library supports associated .index files and lets you save, import and export parameter presets.

  • Community voice store

    Download voice models from Turing Mirror and third-party sources, track progress and resume interrupted downloads.

  • Audio toolbox

    Provides vocal separation, text-to-speech and voice training tools. The training workflow covers audio slicing, pitch and feature extraction, model training and index export.

  • Automatic acceleration

    Supports NVIDIA CUDA and DirectML acceleration for AMD and Intel GPUs. Setup detects hardware and configures the corresponding runtime.

Getting started

  1. Install

    Run RVC_Fabric_Setup.exe. An install path with only English characters is recommended.

  2. Follow the setup

    Follow setup to configure the runtime and download or import a voice model. Install VB-Cable to send audio to another application. Restart the computer after installation.

  3. Connect a voice application

    Set the application output to CABLE Input and the input in QQ, Discord or your streaming application to CABLE Output.

FAQ

Is RVC Fabric free?

Yes. The source code is MIT-licensed on GitHub; model weights, voice packs and third-party resources follow their own licenses.

Does it work without an NVIDIA GPU?

AMD and Intel GPUs can use DirectML for real-time conversion. The current voice training interface requires an NVIDIA GPU.

How do people in my game, QQ or Discord hear the changed voice?

Through the VB-Cable virtual audio device: set RVC Fabric's output to CABLE Input and the other app's microphone to CABLE Output. Keep your headphones as the Windows default playback device.

How is it related to RVC WebUI?

RVC Fabric is based on RVC WebUI and adds a desktop interface, runtime setup, model management and audio tools. RVC WebUI is the upstream project for its voice conversion technology.

Before you use it

Do not use this software to impersonate others, commit fraud or for any other unlawful purpose. Get permission from the rights holder before training on or converting someone else's voice, and follow local laws.
